title: Which central atom receives the mass?
algebra: M = B(ell^2(N)); p1 and p2 are orthogonal rank-one projections
geometry: Categorical central atoms z1,z2,z3; no metric on the spectrum is asserted. Density diagrams show the span of p1 and p2 only; the density is zero on its orthogonal complement.
source_context: M. Takesaki, Theory of Operator Algebras II, XII.4.4(ii)-(iii), printed pp.405-406; all depicted values are derived in BFC41-BFC43.
